title: Pomysł fajny ale niedoskonałość jest
body: Dobrze wykonana ma wszystko co potrzebne do zbudowania nawyków - lista, pomiar, przypomnienia. Niestety gubi dane. W poniedziałek wykonuje ustawione nawyki mam je jako wykonanie. We wtorek rano cofam się na poniedziałek aby zobaczyć jak mi idzie i co widzę ? To co odznaczyłem że zrobione nadal jest w statusie że nie jest zrobione. Dodałbym także przypomnienia powiązane z lokalizacją- czyli jeśli jesteś w danym miejscu to wykonaj to i to.
author: Tomasz Poland

title: Useless
body: I think it would be a simple, great app - if it would be really free. The cost is ridiculous, sadly. I don’t like that you need to pay for more than 3 habits. It’s just useless app that for sure shouldn’t be in these lists with „free” habit trackers.
author: Mariktoria

title: Simple nad intuitive!
body: There is one drawback however - I would be happy with a line chart measuring progress, something like moving average which tells you if your habit trend is generally positive or negative.
author: matik60

title: Simple and nice
body: Very nice and simple app to remind you about the habits.
author: DeEP-Gluttony

title: App crashes in 1 sec, after the newest update
body:
After updating the application and adding new tooth brush habits application crashes each time in just one second. It’s frustrating that this bug haven’t beed identified during QA phase.
- iPhone 10 XS with newst iOS software
author: miroslawdabrowski

title: Problem with sync
body:
Very good app but has major problem with real time sync with watch series 4s.
I have different data in app on phone and different on watch. Have to wait for a long time to sync. Sometimes not syncing at all. For example have diffrerent number of habits on watch. 
Please improve on that and i will give 5 stars
author: slopezs

title: Timezone support
body: Hi! So I really like the app but the problem is that when I travel from Europe to US the streak entries appear on different days than they should. Please fix that!
author: witekbb

title: ok
body: (27 zł na rok) synchronizacja szybka, niestety brak multitasking na ipadzie. ujdzie dopóki nie znajdę lepszego habit manager
author: NieMarek
